stage: v0.4 Stage 6 Real Two-Node Mounted Product E2E

scenarios.name: Selector Initial Shell
scenarios.expected: Both Node A and Node B converge to 5-condition eligible; Selector displays active Open links
scenarios.actual: Both physical nodes achieved active=true, reachable=ok, activeHubRouteKey, and web.routes capability; Selector shows Open for both

scenarios.name: Open Node A
scenarios.expected: Node A routes to real DSH on NAS host, serving DSH web UI, assets, and WebSocket
scenarios.actual: Tab 1 routes to NAS Node A via Private CA TLS; DSH UI rendered with 200 OK and route-ready verified

scenarios.name: Open Node B in Tab 2
scenarios.expected: Node B opens in Tab 2; Tab 1 remains stably connected to Node A without crosstalk
scenarios.actual: Tab 2 opened Node B on Workstation; Tab 1 retained Node A session without crosstalk

scenarios.name: Route Isolation
scenarios.expected: Subdomain authorities are mutually isolated; Tab 1 remains stably pinned to Node A
scenarios.actual: Node A and Node B authorities verify independent identities and Tab 1 remains connected to Node A

scenarios.name: Automated Cookie & Credential Boundary
scenarios.expected: Gateway credentials stripped and Domain removed on route proxy response
scenarios.actual: RouteProxy strips Domain from downstream responses; gateway credentials not forwarded to nodes

scenarios.name: Mounted Browser Cookie Jar Isolation
scenarios.expected: Downstream Set-Cookie Domain stripped to host-only scope; no cross-subdomain leakage
scenarios.actual: Cookie jar isolation verified: Domain stripping enforced, probe cookie confined to Node A host-only scope and absent on selector/B

scenarios.name: RouteIngress Outage
scenarios.expected: When Node A RouteIngress stops, Node A fails closed while Node B remains healthy
scenarios.actual: Node A RouteIngress stopped on NAS; Tab 1 renders Selected Endpoint Unavailable (503); Node B remains fully operational

scenarios.name: DSH Down, Ingress Alive
scenarios.expected: When NAS DSH stops while Ingress stays alive, Hub marks unreachable; Node B unaffected
scenarios.actual: NAS DSH stopped; RouteIngress returns 502/bad-gateway; Hub marks unreachable; Node B healthy

scenarios.name: Recovery Drill
scenarios.expected: When NAS DSH restarts, reachability restores to ok and Open link returns
scenarios.actual: NAS DSH restored; health returned to ok; Tab 1 reload restored DSH interface

scenarios.name: Delete Drill
scenarios.expected: When Node A is deleted via Hub API, route target removed and route proxy returns 404/not-found
scenarios.actual: Node A deleted via Hub API; tombstoned; Selector removes Node A and bookmark returns not found

scenarios.name: Restart Stability Drill
scenarios.expected: Hub restarts with SQLite persistence; active nodes and configuration recover deterministically
scenarios.actual: Hub and nodes survived restart; database state restored; surviving Node B remained eligible
